newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech crown steady against mark, may firm slightly.
newsitem.headline: Czech crown steady against mark, may firm slightly.

text.p: 0820 GMT - Czech crown slightly weaker from opening against mark and seen trading in narrow range today in the absence of market-moving factors and because of U.S. national holiday.
* Crown at 18.517 to the mark after 18.505 at opening, and at 32.400 to the dollar, unchanged from opening.
* Dealers said they expect little movement despite a further easing of the central bank's repo rate to 17.9 percent from 18.1 percent.
*They said trading should be very thin later in the day, as the U.S. is celebrating a national holiday.
*Market waiting for June CPI figures due on Tuesday.
